scriptLines: source1 derive(FechaServicio = iif(     regexMatch(FechaServicio, '(?i)^CONVERT\\s*\\(\\s*DATE\\s*,'),     regexExtract(         FechaServicio,         '(?i)CONVERT\\s*\\(\\s*DATE\\s*,\\s*N?\'([^\']+)\'\\s*,\\s*23\\s*\\)',         1     ),     iif(         regexMatch(FechaServicio, '^\\d+$'),         toString(             addDays(                 toDate('1899-12-30', 'yyyy-MM-dd'),                 toInteger(FechaServicio)             ),             'yyyy-MM-dd'         ),         iif(             regexMatch(FechaServicio, '^\\d{2}/\\d{2}/\\d{4}$'),             toString(toDate(FechaServicio, 'dd/MM/yyyy'), 'yyyy-MM-dd'),             FechaServicio         )     ) ),

RutaHistoricaId = iif(     upper(RutaHistoricaId) == 'RH-07-NEW',     'RH-07',     iif(         regexMatch(upper(RutaHistoricaId), '^RH?-?\\d{1,2}(-[SN])?$'),         concat(             'RH-',             lpad(                 regexExtract(upper(RutaHistoricaId), 'RH?-?(\\d{1,2})', 1),                 2,                 '0'             ),             coalesce(                 regexExtract(upper(RutaHistoricaId), 'RH?-?\\d{1,2}(-[SN])$', 1),                 ''             )         ),         iif(             regexMatch(upper(RutaHistoricaId), '^RUTA\\s+\\d{1,2}$'),             concat(                 'RH-',                 lpad(regexExtract(upper(RutaHistoricaId), 'RUTA\\s+(\\d{1,2})', 1), 2, '0')             ),             iif(                 regexMatch(RutaHistoricaId, '^\\d{1,2}$'),                 concat('RH-', lpad(RutaHistoricaId, 2, '0')),                 toString(null())             )         )     ) ),

ParadaHistoricaId = iif(     isNull(ParadaHistoricaId) || trim(ParadaHistoricaId) == '',     'P023',     iif(         upper(trim(ParadaHistoricaId)) == 'P220-MC-NEW',         'P220',         iif(             regexMatch(upper(trim(ParadaHistoricaId)), '^P\\d{3}$'),             upper(trim(ParadaHistoricaId)),             iif(                 regexMatch(trim(ParadaHistoricaId), '^\\d{1,3}$'),                 concat('P', lpad(trim(ParadaHistoricaId), 3, '0')),                 'P023'             )         )     ) ),

Franja = iif(     regexMatch(         Franja,         '^([01]\\d|2[0-3]):[0-5]\\d-([01]\\d|2[0-3]):[0-5]\\d$'     )     && substring(Franja, 1, 5) < substring(Franja, 7, 5),     Franja,     toString(null()) ),

derivedColumn1 derive(AnioFuente = iif(     regexMatch(AnioFuente, '^\\d{4}$'),     toShort(AnioFuente),     iif(         regexMatch(FechaServicio, '^\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}$'),         toShort(regexExtract(FechaServicio, '^(\\d{4})-', 1)),         toShort(null())     ) ),
DemandaNoAtendida = iif(     regexMatch(DemandaNoAtendida, '^\\d+$'),     toInteger(DemandaNoAtendida),     toInteger(null()) )) ~> derivedColumn2
derivedColumn2 derive(FechaServicio = iif(     isDate(FechaServicio, 'yyyy-MM-dd'),     toDate(FechaServicio, 'yyyy-MM-dd'),     toDate(null()) )) ~> derivedColumn3

derivedColumn3 derive(DemandaId = iif(     isNull(DemandaId) || trim(DemandaId) == '',     concat(         'DM-',         toString(AnioFuente),         '-',         substring(             sha2(                 256,                 AnioFuente,                 FechaServicio,                 RutaHistoricaId,                 ParadaHistoricaId,                 Franja,                 ValidacionesTarjeta,                 Descensos,                 DemandaNoAtendida,                 Metodo             ),             1,             20         )     ),     DemandaId )) ~> derivedColumn4
